entities.name: Antonín Dvořák Theatre
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Antonín Dvořák Theatre is an opera house in Ostrava, Czech Republic, which opened in 1907. Since 1919, it has been one of two permanent venues of the National Moravian Silesian Theatre.
